about.title: About
about.heroHeadline: Built by one developer. Designed for everyone.
paragraphs: ArcSmith Apps is an independent app studio based in Warsaw, Poland. We build thoughtful, privacy-first mobile applications — each designed to do one thing well.

Behind ArcSmith is a developer with over 13 years of experience in software engineering. Every app is built with modern tools and best practices — following the same standards you'd expect from a larger team.
We believe great apps should work for you, not the other way around. No investor pressure, no growth hacks — just tools that do what they promise.
